newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan Duty Free offer 1.25 mln dinar public issue.
newsitem.headline: Jordan Duty Free offer 1.25 mln dinar public issue.

text.p: Jordan Duty Free Company, a newly established public shareholding company, announced on Monday a public offer for 25 percent of its five million dinar ($7.1 million) capital, company officials said.

The company which plans to own and manage free trade shops along border crossings with Israel and the West Bank has set November 14 as a closing date for the public offer of 1.25 million shares at one dinar each.
The public offering, with a minimum of 1,000 shares per subscriber, is offered to Amman Stock Exchange investors from October 26.

Twenty-three major state and private investors are founding shareholders, including state-owned Jordan Investment Coporation, national carrier Royal Jordanian (RJ), Jordan Investment and Finance Bank. They have already covered the first instalment of the company's 75 percent equity capital in a private placement.
Company founders have pinned hopes on business generated by increased cross border traffic between Jordan and the Palestinian territories and Israel in the wake of Middle East peace.
